parsed.note_claim: Ceuta was acquired by Portugal in 1415 and Melilla by Spain in 1497, both before Morocco's 1956 independence.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 1415 - Portugal seizes control of Ceuta. 1497 - Spain conquers Melilla... 1956 - Spain retains Ceuta and Melilla after Morocco becomes independent.
parsed.reason: The timeline section explicitly confirms the 1415, 1497, and 1956 dates asserted in the note.
